younger: My younger sister is learning to play the piano this year.
我妹妹今年正在学弹钢琴。
older: The older students helped the new ones find their classrooms.
年纪大一些的学生帮新生找到了教室。
taller: Tom is taller than his brother, but his brother runs faster.
汤姆比他哥哥高，但他哥哥跑得更快。
shorter: The days get shorter when winter is coming.
冬天来临时，白天变得更短。
longer: This rope is longer than the one we used yesterday.
这根绳子比我们昨天用的那根更长。
thinner: After three months of exercise, he looks much thinner.
锻炼三个月后，他看上去瘦多了。
heavier: This box is heavier than it looks, so please lift it carefully.
这个箱子比看上去重，请小心搬。
bigger: They moved to a bigger house near the park last month.
上个月他们搬进了公园附近一个更大的房子。
smaller: The smaller of the two cakes tastes just as good.
两块蛋糕中较小的那块味道一样好。
stronger: Regular exercise makes your body stronger and healthier.
经常锻炼能让身体更强壮、更健康。
smarter: She is smarter than before because she reads every day.
她比以前更聪明了，因为她每天都读书。
cleaned: We cleaned the classroom together after school yesterday.
昨天放学后我们一起打扫了教室。
stayed: He stayed at home and did his homework last Sunday.
上周日他待在家里做作业。
washed: My mother washed all the clothes this morning.
今天早上我妈妈把所有衣服都洗了。
watched: We watched an interesting film last night.
昨晚我们看了一部有趣的电影。
had: She had a fever, so she didn't go to school.
她发烧了，所以没去上学。
had a cold: I had a cold last week and couldn't go out to play.
我上周感冒了，不能出去玩。
slept: The baby slept quietly for three hours this afternoon.
今天下午宝宝安静地睡了三个小时。
drank: He drank a glass of milk before going to bed.
他睡觉前喝了一杯牛奶。
faster: The new train is much faster than the old one.
新火车比旧火车快得多。
fixed: My father fixed my broken bike in ten minutes.
我爸爸十分钟就修好了我坏掉的自行车。
went: She went to the library to borrow some books yesterday.
昨天她去图书馆借了几本书。
went camping: We went camping by the lake and enjoyed the fresh air.
我们去湖边野营，享受着新鲜的空气。
went fishing: Grandpa went fishing by the river early in the morning.
爷爷一大早就去河边钓鱼了。
rode: The children rode their bikes around the playground happily.
孩子们开心地骑着自行车绕着操场转。
ate: We ate lunch at school and then took a short rest.
我们在学校吃了午饭，然后休息了一会儿。
took: She took many photos of the beautiful sunset.
她拍了许多美丽日落的照片。
took pictures: They took pictures of each other in front of the old tree.
他们在那棵老树前互相拍照。
bought: I bought a new dictionary from the bookstore yesterday.
昨天我在书店买了一本新词典。
fell: The workers felled several old trees to make the road wider.
工人们砍倒了几棵老树，把路修得更宽。
Labour Day: We visited the farm with our family on Labour Day.
劳动节那天我们和家人一起参观了农场。
Turpan: They tasted sweet grapes when they traveled to Turpan.
他们去吐鲁番旅行时品尝了甜甜的葡萄。
licked: The little boy licked the ice cream happily in the sun.
小男孩在阳光下开心地舔着冰淇淋。
laughed: Everyone laughed when the dog began to dance.
当那只狗开始跳舞时，大家都笑了。
dining hall: The students are having lunch in the dining hall now.
学生们正在食堂吃午饭。
cycling: Cycling is a popular sport among young people.
骑自行车是年轻人中很流行的一项运动。
go cycling: We often go cycling in the park on weekends.
我们周末经常去公园骑自行车。
ice-skate: Children love to ice-skate on the lake in winter.
冬天孩子们喜欢在湖上滑冰。
look up: You can look up the new words in a dictionary.
你可以用词典查这些生词。
Internet: We can find lots of useful information on the Internet.
我们可以在互联网上找到很多有用的信息。
